title: He Is Risen… Now What? — Colossians 3:1
paragraphs: He Is Risen… Now What? — Colossians 3:1
He walked out of the grave.
So why are so many believers still living like they’re buried?
“Since, then, you have been raised with Christ, set your hearts on things above…” — Colossians 3:1
Resurrection is not just a moment we celebrate.
It is a life we step into.

Jesus did not rise so you could stay chained to the same pride, the same secret sin, the same fear, the same old appetite that kept crushing your soul. He rose to pull you into a new way of living. New desires. New direction. New obedience.
A risen Christ demands a risen life.
You cannot sing about the empty tomb on Sunday and then crawl back into dead things on Monday. Not if you belong to Him. Not if His blood bought you. Not if His Spirit lives in you.
Colossians 3:1 is a summons. Lift your eyes. Set your heart higher. Stop feeding what Jesus came to bury. Start pursuing what He died and rose to give—holiness, purity, mercy, truth, courage, love.

And when you fail—and sometimes you will—you do not run back to shame. You run to Christ. The same Savior who rose from the grave still receives repentant sinners with nail-scarred hands and unstoppable grace.

Now we seek Him.
Now we surrender.
Now we live like the tomb is still empty.

And that means your past does not get the final word.
Your addiction does not get the final word.
Your guilt does not get the final word.
